# mcp-state

> High-signal, low-noise agent state management over MCP stdio.

## Overview
mcp-state is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that implements the blackboard pattern for AI agent state management using embedded SQLite.

## Source Code
https://github.com/JohnnytheShark/mcp-state

## Tools
- `read_blackboard(session_id)` — Read the full JSON state for a session
- `patch_blackboard(session_id, json_patch)` — Merge a JSON patch into the active state
- `archive_subtask(session_id, key_to_archive)` — Move a key to cold storage to keep the active blackboard small

## Protocol
- MCP 2024-11-05 over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0)

## Database
- Active state: `active_blackboard` table (hot, small, frequently accessed)
- Archived data: `cold_storage` table (durable audit log)

## Use Cases
- Persist agent working state across conversation turns
- Coordinate multi-agent workflows via a shared blackboard
- Prevent context window bloat by archiving completed subtasks

## Quick Start
```
cargo run --release
```

## Documentation
https://johnnytheshark.github.io/mcp-state/
